items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Ab Frank isn't on there, I guess, a piccolo player, is there? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Well at the time I was such a youngster I couldn't remember.

You can shut this off at any time when you have to. Hey, we're talking about that photograph of the Peerless band. Yeah. Well, Ab Frank isn't on there, I guess, a piccolo player, is there? I don't think.
